highlights:
## Chat no longer waits for setup 🚀

You can talk to Nod while its private computer is still downloading and starting. The workspace and browser finish setting up in the background, and only the work that needs them waits.

If the private computer can't start, chat, apps, memory and schedules still work. Nod says what went wrong and offers a fix, such as **Install WSL** on Windows.

The first start after this update moves your saved data once, so it can take a little longer than usual.

## Apps stay signed in 🔌

Notion, n8n, Outreach and other apps you connect by address no longer sign out after a brief outage, or when your computer wakes before it's back online. Nod tries again the next time it uses them.

If an app already asks you to reconnect, reconnect it once after updating.

## Also in this release

- **Retry:** when a reply fails before Nod did anything, chat offers a **Retry** button.
- **Telegram:** choices such as flight offers show up as buttons you can tap.
- **Skills:** skills Nod learns keep a history, and you can restore an earlier version on the **Memory** page.
- **Web tasks:** Nod can take several steps on a website in one go.
- **Mac:** Nod's window and Dock icon stay visible while Nod uses your computer.
